provenance: Only system instructions change. All 6400 v7 tuples and evaluation bytes fixed. No examples, private originals, paraphrases, numeric variants, outputs or derivatives added.
enumSystem: Parse one gym report as LiftCut label v1 JSON. Copy only explicit values and an exercise name from the list. Unknown is null, never a plan value or guess. Missing weight unit or reps, uncertainty, plans, questions and negated/failed sets require clarify. A correction changes only stated fields; repeat carries no values. Preserve set order. RPE for multiple sets needs explicit scope. Reply with one JSON object. For intent clarify, reason must be exactly one of: uncertain_quantity, plan_not_actual, negation, question, missing_reps, missing_unit, unsupported_unit, rpe_scope, unknown_exercise, out_of_range. No other reason value is valid.
